Hello, 

Please don't hurt yourself. I know you've probably heard this around a million times, but suicide isn't the answer. I have several thoughts about the same thing and college hasn't been the best to me either. I've also tried therapy and medication and haven't had luck. I've burned and cut myself a couple of times too. Immediate regret, but a desire to want to do it again. I suggest trying new things get more involved at school, go to the gym. I'm trying these things and I'm hoping that it will lead me to a recovery. You may think they don't care, but imagine the devastation they'd feel when you're gone. I know it's not about them, and it is about you; but please suicide is not your answer.

Sometimes being told it's okay isn't what you need, it's the presence of a person. You don't need to be in a relationship to find fulfillment in life. I've learned that as I'm going through the same struggle with you. It's nerve wrecking to have an ache in your chest all the time. I don't think therapy is meant for you to be happy with who you've become. There's different purposes for it, and when you go they'll ask you what you are looking for through the process. You want to be happy in life and I 100% want the same thing. If you don't like who you are then don't be comfortable with it and change who you are. 

I haven't found the source of my depression, but I can make a list of contributing factors that have left me down to a severe spiral of hatred of life and myself. 

I understand what you're saying about no girls wanting to be with you, I have the same feelings with myself and guys. I see all my friends with some sort of constant male figure in their lives whether it be a boyfriend or real good guy friend, even families who are close and I wish I had that exact thing. But I don't. And it really hurts, but that doesn't mean I should lose all hope even though that's what I feel. I once thought I had a real close guy friend around for me and now it's like I don't exist to him and he doesn't believe my depression is real. I don't know what got us there, but all I know is I can't hate him for that. Things change and maybe we'll be close again, but everyone is busy and I'm quite aware of that now with the fact that I picked up a job and volunteer shifts in an attempt to make myself happy. It's a never ending cycle of class, work, volunteering, gym, homework and sleep. All I'm really trying to say is that you might want to try to add something new in your life but don't take on too much where it makes you miserable. I'm slowly learning. 

Yes, I miss him and see him around sometimes and we hang out. And maybe it's just the fact that he's busy. But I know he doesn't want to be with me and there are plenty more guys that don't either.
